# at the PR 2 base 53c59ce. Presented as the Kef make/kill roundtrip swapping
# ring ownership between the two re-made faces; diagnosis showed the surgery
# restores raw ring ownership EXACTLY — the real bug was the iso oracle's

# components leaking into the face section's outer/ring pairing (false
# negative between isomorphic bodies). Fixed in iso.rs (committed-label
# references in dart_attachment); fast counterpart:
# seqgen::tests::issue_60_kef_roundtrip_on_coincident_ring_twins.
